deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Please note that these instructions are specific to Shopify's admin interface.
To embed a returns reason capture form into your Shopify returns flow, follow these steps:
1. Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to "Settings" > "Policies"
3. Scroll down to the "Return Reason" section and click on the "Add Return Reason" button
4. Enter a name for your return reason and select the type (e.g., 'Damaged', 'Defective', etc.)
5. To embed the returns reason capture form, you'll need to add a new section to your return policy template
6. In the "Return Policy" tab, click on the "Templates" button next to the return policy name
7. Click on the "Edit Template" button and then select the "Add Section" option from the dropdown menu
8. Choose the "Form" section type and add a new form field with the label 'Reason for Return'
9. Configure the form field settings as desired (e.g., make it required, set a specific format, etc.)
10. Save your changes to the return policy template
11. To display the returns reason capture form on your store's returns page, you'll need to add a new section to your theme's liquid files
12. In the Shopify admin panel, navigate to "Online Store" > "Themes"
13. Click on the "Actions" dropdown menu next to your active theme and select "Edit code"
14. Open the `templates/returns.liquid` file and add a new section with the returns reason capture form
15. Use Shopify's liquid syntax to render the form field values and display them in the correct format
16. Save your changes to the `returns.liquid` file and preview your store's returns page to test the embedded form
